facts.fact: The document states that Decree 25/2025 of 3 March ordered the taking of the Fifth General Population and Housing Census (CGPV-V) and the First General Agricultural Census, and was read at the meeting.
facts.system: CGPV-V (V Censo General de Poblacion y Vivienda)

facts.fact: INEGE held the first meeting of the Scientific Committee of the Fifth Census on 20 August 2026, presenting and validating the census strategic documents, project document, social-mobilisation communication document and resource-mobilisation strategy; no enumeration date is stated.
